question: What is the growth plan for Frontline?
html:
Frontline growth plan

Frontline's growth plan is to earn more per law firm, move down into mid-size firms, consolidate eBilling and accounts receivable, then expand to the UK and Canada. The work runs in four overlapping phases over about 42 months. Because Frontline was bought at roughly 12-15x (est.), EBITDA growth has to carry the return (Frontline growth plan).

Starting point at close

  • BSP closed on Dec 9, 2024 with $136.95M of equity and a $90M NXT Capital and Audax term loan. Carlyle AlpInvest added $12.5M directly (Frontline public filings).
  • Revenue was about $100-140M and adjusted EBITDA about $16-20M (both est., low to medium confidence) (Frontline public filings).
  • The company had about 1,100 staff in Jan 2026 and 900+ law-firm clients, including roughly half the AM Law 200 (Frontline growth plan).

Four phases

  1. Months 0-12: deepen the AM Law base.
  • Turn HELIX into a product-led service desk with a Tier-0 AI agent.
  • Add a cyber-posture subscription and legal-AI enablement.
  • ILTA finds 68% of firms have Copilot, but only 8% have deployed it firm-wide.
  1. Months 6-18: move into the mid-market.
  • Target 143 mid-size firms with 17,042 attorneys across 16 metros. Of these, 37 score 65+ (Mid-size law firms).
  • The top-ranked firms are Weber Gallagher (85), Evans & Dixon (83) and Rivkin Radler (82).
  • Buy local legal MSPs such as Kraft Kennedy (about $21.5M revenue, est.) and Innovative Computing Systems (about $12.6M, est.) (Frontline and Thomas Scientific add-on targets).
  1. Months 12-30: consolidate eBilling and AR.
  • Client-side AI has pushed invoice rejections from 11% to 18%.
  • Candidates include Helm360, The Garver Group and The Legal Billing Group.
  • Run four finance agents priced on days-to-pay.
  1. Months 24-42: expand internationally.
  • Enter the UK and Canada through acquired providers such as Quiss, Accurate Legal Billing and CG Technologies.

Roadmap (all est.)

MonthRevenueAdj. EBITDAHeadcountClients
0$130M$20M1,150900
12$150M$25M1,3001,000
24$180M$32M1,5001,150
36$215M$41M1,6501,300

The roadmap assumes about 9-10% organic growth plus about $55M of acquired revenue by month 36. It also assumes margin rises from about 15.4% to about 19% (Frontline growth plan).

Key uncertainties

  • Every revenue and EBITDA figure comes from leverage and headcount assumptions, not company disclosures (Frontline public filings).
  • ZoomInfo revenue estimates for targets are directional only. Helm360's $116.5M is flagged as likely overstated (Frontline and Thomas Scientific add-on targets).
  • The filings do not disclose any revolver, delayed-draw or incremental debt capacity, so acquisition funding headroom is unknown.

Next actions

  • Replace the est. baseline with management's actual trailing revenue, EBITDA and client counts, then re-run the roadmap.
  • Confirm debt capacity for acquisitions with the NXT Capital and Audax lenders before outreach to Phase 2 targets.
  • Validate revenue for Kraft Kennedy and Innovative Computing Systems through direct conversations rather than ZoomInfo.
  • Pilot the Tier-0 agent and cyber subscription with a small set of AM Law clients. Track deflection rate and attach rate against the month-12 margin assumption.

   - Run four finance agents priced on days-to-pay.
4. **Months 24-42: expand internationally.**
   - Enter the UK and Canada through acquired providers such as Quiss, Accurate Legal Billing and CG Technologies.

## Roadmap (all est.)

| Month | Revenue | Adj. EBITDA | Headcount | Clients |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | $130M | $20M | 1,150 | 900 |
| 12 | $150M | $25M | 1,300 | 1,000 |
| 24 | $180M | $32M | 1,500 | 1,150 |
| 36 | $215M | $41M | 1,650 | 1,300 |

- Every revenue and EBITDA figure comes from leverage and headcount assumptions, not company disclosures (Frontline public filings).
- ZoomInfo revenue estimates for targets are directional only. Helm360's $116.5M is flagged as likely overstated (Frontline and Thomas Scientific add-on targets).
- The filings do not disclose any revolver, delayed-draw or incremental debt capacity, so acquisition funding headroom is unknown.

- Confirm debt capacity for acquisitions with the NXT Capital and Audax lenders before outreach to Phase 2 targets.
